events.name: The Borrowed Team
events.intro:
A referee holds out two hats. One is yours. One is theirs. Nobody has told the Pokémon yet.

**Referee:** "Exhibition rules. You wear theirs. They wear yours. So do the Pokémon."

**{borrow:name}:** {borrow:dont}

*Your lead looks from the rival to you, and back again. It has never been asked to trust a stranger before.*

success.text: You put on their hat. It is a size too big, and warm, and smells faintly of their bag. The Pokémon are led across the ring.
You hand the hat back. The referee shrugs; the rival laughs, a little relieved. Your Pokémon lean against your legs.

events.name: The Borrowed Team: The Match
events.intro:
You stand at the edge of the ring with their team at your feet. Their moves. Their habits. Their quiet, particular ways of waiting.

Across from you, {borrow:name} holds **your** team. Your {borrow:mine} is in front, looking over its shoulder at you.

*Behind you, {borrow:theirs} looks across the ring at its trainer, then at you. It has not decided what to do about this.*

success.text: The referee drops his hand. Each Pokémon glances over its shoulder first, then obeys.

lose.text: Lost an exhibition with the rival's team, while the rival used yours.

win.text: Won an exhibition with the rival's team, while the rival used yours.

events.name: The Borrowed Team: Hats Off

remembers.notice: *The referee raises your arm. It was the rival's team that did the winning, and the rival is trying hard not to look proud of them.*
*The referee raises the rival's arm. Your own team did that, without you. They keep looking back at you to see if you mind.*

events.intro:
The hats come off. Each Pokémon goes home, slowly, and not in a straight line.

A {borrow:theirs} lingers at your knee a moment longer than it needs to. Across the ring, your {borrow:mine} has stopped beside {borrow:name} and will not be moved.

**{borrow:name}:** {borrow:after}

*You know their team now: every move, every habit. They know yours. Neither of you says so.*

success.text: The referee collects both hats and folds them over one arm. For a moment you and the rival just stand there, knowing each other a little too well.
